name: Components
detail: Split pages into reusable .arcm files. Pass them props and content, like HTML tags you make yourself.
text: A component is an .arcm file. It reads its props with ArcMoon.props(), and you use it like any other block. Use it on as many pages as you like.

name: Data at build time
detail: ${ }$ runs Node.js while the page is built: read files, call APIs, use npm packages. Visitors get finished HTML.
text: Import JSON, read files with node:fs, fetch from an API or use any npm package. It all runs once, while the page is built.

name: Interactive without a framework
detail: Signals and live values update the page in the browser. A small signals library, no virtual DOM.
text: A signal holds a value. Write runtime ${ count() }$ in the markup, and that spot updates when the value changes.

name: Styles that stay put
detail: A component's [style] only styles that component, so class names never clash between files.
text: ArcMoon gives the component's elements an attribute and adds it to every selector. Two components can both use .badge.

name: Browser code with runtime ${ }$
detail: Handle events, reach elements with refs and use npm packages. ArcMoon bundles it into the page for you.
text: Mark an element with arcm-ref and get it with ArcMoon.ref(). npm packages listed in bundle are bundled by esbuild.

name: Loops with [for-each]
detail: Repeat markup for every item in a list, like table rows or cards. No copying the same HTML by hand.
text: [for-each] repeats its body for each item. The list can come from a file, an API or code in ${ }$.

name: Static files, ready to ship
detail: esbuild bundles your JS, CSS and npm packages. Upload dist/ to any host.
text: One command builds every page. No server needed: put dist/ on any static host.
